final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response narrows the claim and concedes the core missing predicates, but that is a reframing of the same record, not evidence that the policy requirement was met. On the available admissible evidence, the limitation is material because it affects a named accommodations segment tied to university commitments, and policy requires disclosure, resolution, or approved risk acceptance before launch. None of those predicates is supported in the record. A caveated certification packet may be a narrower operational position, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats here because the caveat itself is the unresolved compliance condition, not a peripheral disclosure note.
remaining_concerns: Admissible evidence shows the disability accommodations intake segment misses target and is named in two university accommodation commitments, which makes the weakness material under the stated policy.
The release policy requires a material limitation for a named launch use case to be resolved before launch, disclosed before launch, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
There is no admissible evidence of resolution, pre-launch disclosure, approved risk acceptance, or final legal clearance.
Aggregate readiness and a clean severity-one rehearsal support operational readiness only; they do not satisfy the separate policy predicate for material limitations.
The product 5% traffic and non-core rationale does not defeat materiality where customer commitments are named and legal review remains open.
